summary: AIR Global PLC filed a Form 6-K on June 8, 2026, attaching a press release detailing key metrics following the closing of its business combination with Cantor Equity Partners III, Inc. (CAEP), a SPAC. The Nasdaq-listed entity (AIIR) reports ~160.39M shares outstanding, a US$6.91 closing price, and a Forward Purchase Agreement with Harraden Circle for ~5M shares at a redemption price of US$10.49, enhancing liquidity. Earnout shares vest at US$12.50/US$15.00 thresholds by May 31, 2031. The company also reports ~US$268M net debt. Watch for stock price dynamics and FPA valuation date.
